en:
## New Features

- Image generation results are now saved to the filesystem instead of storing large base64 data in the database
- Streaming blocks (text, web search, image generation) are ordered by outputIndex for correct interleaving
- Anthropic model list fetching automatically retries with gateway suffix stripping and /v1 fallback for third-party proxies

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed image generation interruption check: only skip when block_complete carries actual result data, preventing silent loss of unpersisted images when the stream breaks mid-generation
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 图片生成结果保存到文件系统，避免大体积 base64 数据存入数据库
- 流式输出块（文本、网页搜索、图片生成）按 outputIndex 排序，确保交错顺序正确
- Anthropic 模型列表获取支持自动剥离网关后缀和追加 /v1 重试，兼容更多第三方中转

## 修复

- 修复图片生成中断检查：仅在 block_complete 携带实际 result 数据时才跳过，防止流中断时图片未持久化却不触发恢复
